title: Chapter 248 Discussing Strategies
content:
Chapter 248 Discussing Strategies

So, he stood up and bowed, saying: "Lord, as far as I know, there are quite a few guards in Nanshanji, more than a thousand of them. If we attack by force, even if we can break into the city wall, we will probably suffer heavy losses. I think we should make full use of our cavalry advantage to lure the enemy out of the city and start a field battle."

When Wang Shuo heard this, he agreed with what Gude said, but he still wanted to hear what others thought.

"Does the military advisor have any good ideas?"

Zou Wenjie was shocked. This is his job to make plans!

He pondered for a while, waved his feather fan, and said slowly: "Lord, the enemy is numerous and we are few. Although our soldiers are well-trained, Nanshanji has thousands of elite soldiers, whose level is almost twice as high. In terms of strength, we are still one step behind. Moreover, Nanshanji has tens of thousands of gang members. They may become our enemies when we attack Nanshanji."

"I think we can alienate these gang forces and make them work for me. At the critical moment, we can turn against them and greatly increase our chances of winning."

Wang Shuo's eyes lit up. This plan is very good!

"Uh, Yuanjie, your idea is very good. Tell me in detail."

"Lord, most of these gang members are like mothers who feed them. As long as we promise them enough benefits, many people will be tempted."

"Kungfu, equipment... even the ancient battlefield dungeon are all bargaining chips in our hands."

Wang Shuo heard this and thought about it.

He originally planned to open the ancient battlefield dungeon to players.

A place where you can spawn monsters infinitely is very tempting for players who want to upgrade their levels.

Moreover, your own resource exchange place can also be opened to players. As long as the authority to exchange strategic resources is closed, there will be no problem.

At the same time, the more resources you exchange, the more you can promote the upgrade of resource exchange stones, which is killing two birds with one stone.

Everyone talked to each other, the atmosphere was quite lively, and one strategy after another was proposed and gradually improved by everyone.

It was not until late at night that Wang Shuo asked everyone to go back to rest.

Lying on the bed, Wang Shuo thought that he seemed to have a think tank.

"Chang Gui, what do you think of the strategy we discussed today?"

"Lord, I think our pattern should be bigger, and the allies we contact are not limited to Nanshanji."

"There are many oppressed lords near Nanshanji, and they are also the power we can unite."

Wang Shuo sat up suddenly, and his face instantly became exciting.

"Yes, why didn't I think of it!"

This is a huge force, and it will be stronger than the gangs in Nanshanji.

Moreover, it is more difficult to unite them than to unite with gang forces.

They are essentially hostile forces to Nanshanji.

When the Undead Legion revives, fighting alone will inevitably lead to death. They must form an alliance to fight against the overwhelming undead.

Thinking of this, Wang Shuo was so excited that he couldn't sleep.

Countless ideas in his mind were like a flash flood, which was out of control!

The next morning, Wang Shuo handed over the matter of inciting the local gangs of Nanshanji to Zou Yuanjie.

The two discussed the conditions that could be promised to those gangs, and gave him some resources.

And Wang Shuo opened the "Village Leader Group".

In recent days, the group has been discussing the oppression of them by the system towns.

Some territories were even directly incorporated by nearby towns, making the major lords miserable!
